plan.title: design-critique first-line model slug on triage and critic comments

narratives.Description: Require a first-line model slug on the triage write-back and on every critic comment. Comment field, not an issue label, not a GitHub login. Adjacent to #3627; do not merge the issues.
narratives.Origin: GitHub issue #3628. Parent #3434. Body is the SoT (zero comments at ingest). Refs ADR-005, #1423, #3602, #3627 (adjacent; do not merge).
narratives.Overview: A reader and a later synthesizer must see which model wrote the lean and which model wrote the critique without inferring it from the host or spawn metadata. Canonical lead line is `model: <slug>` (example `model: grok-4.6`). Same rule for Stop 4 retry critics. Synthesis comments SHOULD do the same.
narratives.UserStory: As a later synthesizer, I want the first line of the triage write-back and each critic comment to name the model, so I do not guess same-family vs cross-family from the host.
narratives.When: When the contract (and brief if needed) requires a first-line model slug on the triage write-back and every critic comment, the thin skill only points at that rule, a content-contract test locks the first-line requirement, and docs say this is a comment field not an issue label.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Comment-lead field only. ⊗ Issue label for the model. ⊗ GitHub login / author / role name in place of the model. ⊗ Infer the model from verify:routing or spawn metadata and omit it from the comment. Do not implement #3627 in this PR. Do not auto-dispatch (#3578). Do not close #3434. Do not thicken the skill past the line cap.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Edit content/contracts/design-critique.md Stop 3 / write-back recording; add a model field to content/templates/design-critique-brief.md if the envelope must copy onto the comment; thin skill pointer only; content-contract test; CHANGELOG Unreleased. Verify with pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/content-contracts. Separate PR from #3627. Closes #3628.

narrative.When: When content/contracts/design-critique.md is read, it requires a first-line machine-findable model slug on the triage write-back and on every critic comment, including a Stop 4 retry critic, and forbids putting the model in an issue label or replacing it with a GitHub login.
narrative.Acceptance: When content/contracts/design-critique.md is read, it requires a first-line machine-findable model slug on the triage write-back and on every critic comment, including a Stop 4 retry critic, and forbids putting the model in an issue label or replacing it with a GitHub login.
